messages:
Lee (Customer-Security): Hey all — for the POC the security team needs concrete evidence of our logging/monitoring controls. Specifically: SIEM delivery path, immutable retention, admin activity logging (who changed model config), and a reproducible export flow for e-discovery. What artifacts can you provide?

Sam (SalesEng): Thanks Lee. Quick q — retention windows you need for the POC vs enterprise contract?

Lee (Customer-Security): For the POC they want to validate: 2 years for user events, 7 years for admin/audit, and WORM for the most recent 90 days.

Alex (AE): We can provide a package: 1) sample SIEM ingest config (syslog/CEF/JSONL), 2) a sanitized admin activity export (JSONL + CSV), 3) signed manifest for exports, 4) retention/lifecycle policy snippets (S3 + Glacier), and 5) a short playbook for Splunk/Elastic ingestion.

Maria (Solutions): I'll drop a minimal admin export sample and the curl we use for log exports in this thread.

Maria (Solutions): ```
# sample audit log (JSONL)
{"timestamp":"2026-02-10T14:12:03Z","actor":"admin@acme.com","action":"model.update","target":"model:rlhf-v2","ip":"18.205.33.7","request_id":"req_abc123","session_id":"sess_789"}
```

Maria (Solutions): Export command (admin API):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/logs/export" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"start":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-02-28T23:59:59Z","format":"jsonl","include":"admin_activity,access_events"}'
```

Jordan (CISO): Do exports include a signed manifest / chain-of-custody? We need tamper-evidence for audit.

Sam (SalesEng): Yes — every export produces: 1) the data bundle, 2) a manifest with SHA256 hashes for each file, 3) a manifest signature (service-side, KMS-backed), and 4) an audit entry that records export_id, requester, and timestamp. We also store the export hash in the append-only audit stream.

Lee (Customer-Security): Show example manifest and how we verify signatures please. Also what endpoints to connect to for Splunk?

Maria (Solutions): example manifest (sanitized):
```json
{"export_id":"exp_20260210_01","created_by":"system","created_at":"2026-02-10T14:15:00Z","files":[{"path":"admin-logs-20260210.jsonl","sha256":"e3b0c44298fc1c149afb..."}],"signature":"sig_v1:BASE64SIG..."}
```

Maria (Solutions): Verification steps we'll include in the playbook: 1) download bundle, 2) recompute SHA256 on files, 3) verify manifest signature against Redwood KMS pubkey (we provide cert), 4) confirm export_id present in audit stream.

Maria (Solutions): For Splunk we recommend either: forwarder -> S3 -> indexer (S3 input) or push via HEC. We'll share HEC config snippet and a sample S3 lifecycle policy.

redwood-deploy-bot: export job started: job_id=exp_20260210_01, status=running

Alex (AE): I'll package a sanitized export for them and a short playbook doc. When do we want to handoff the POC tenant?

Lee (Customer-Security): Next Monday morning PT would work for the security review.

Sam (SalesEng): Maria/Alex — can you prepare two artifacts before then: 1) sanitized admin activity sample (emails redacted), and 2) a playbook with Splunk/Elastic steps + verification checklist?

Maria (Solutions): On it. I'll also include S3 Object Lock / Governance guidance for immutability. Snippet example below.

Maria (Solutions): ```json
{"Rules":[{"ID":"ImmutabilityRule","Status":"Enabled","Expiration":{"Days":3650}}]}
```

Jordan (CISO): Also include how deletion attempts are audited (deletion events, who/when), and how we enforce retention (lifecycle + policy enforcement + alerts).

Maria (Solutions): We'll add a section: deletion audit trail + alerting via Console + webhook.

Alex (AE): Created internal task #task-5234 to assemble evidence package and schedule the handoff call.

Lee (Customer-Security): One last ask: can you provide proof that admin activity entries are tamper-evident (e.g., HMAC chain or external ledger)? We need that for vendor risk.

Sam (SalesEng): We maintain an append-only audit store. Each entry includes an HMAC chain and optional external export to a customer-provided KMS-backed object store. We'll add the HMAC verification example to the playbook.

Maria (Solutions): ETA for artifacts: Friday EOD PT. I'll post links and a sanitized export in this thread.

redwood-deploy-bot: export job completed: job_id=exp_20260210_01, status=completed, url=https://s3.redwood/prod/exports/exp_20260210_01.tar.gz

Lee (Customer-Security): Received — I'll validate contents and confirm by next Wednesday. Thanks everyone.

Sam (SalesEng): Thanks team :thumbsup:
